      WHEN upper(trim(s.GSserved)) LIKE 'K%' THEN -1

WITH latest_frpm_year AS (
  SELECT MAX("Academic Year") AS academic_year
  FROM frpm
),
charter_coe AS (
  SELECT
    f."Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_k12,
    s."StatusType"
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN latest_frpm_year AS y
    ON f."Academic Year" = y.academic_year
  JOIN schools AS s
    ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
  WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
    AND s."Charter" = 1
    AND f."District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
    AND f."Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
)
SELECT
  funding_type,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "StatusType" = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currently_operating_schools,
  SUM(enrollment_k12) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  SUM(frpm_k12) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM charter_coe
GROUP BY funding_type
ORDER BY CASE funding_type
  WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Locally funded' THEN 2
END;

    WHERE CDSCode = '01612590125716'
),

    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f."County Name" AS county_name,
        f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter,
        ROUND(
            f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0 /
            NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0),

        ROUND(
            f."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 100.0 /

            2
        ) AS frpm_pct

    JOIN target_county AS c
      ON f."County Code" = c."County Code"
    WHERE CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) <= 12

      AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500

),
sat_by_school AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS sat_total
    FROM satscores
    WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
      AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT
    MIN(e.county_name) AS county_name,
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,

    END AS collector_num
  FROM cards AS c

WITH borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opening_date,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE a.district_id = (
        SELECT district_id
        FROM district
        WHERE A2 = 'Prachatice'
    )
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date
),
households AS (
    SELECT
        b.account_id,
        b.opening_date,
        b.total_borrowed,
        c.district_id AS home_district_id
    FROM borrowing_accounts AS b
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.account_id = b.account_id
       AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        h.account_id,
        h.opening_date,
        h.total_borrowed,
        d.A2 AS home_district,
        d.A4 AS district_population,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY d.A4 DESC
        ) AS population_rank
    FROM households AS h
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = h.home_district_id
)
SELECT
    r.account_id AS account_number,
    r.opening_date AS account_opening_date,
    r.total_borrowed,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.account)
        FROM trans AS t
        WHERE t.account_id = r.account_id
          AND t.operation IN ('PREVOD Z UCTU', 'PREVOD NA UCET')
          AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
          AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    ) AS outside_bank_counterparties,
    r.home_district,
    r.district_population,
    r.population_rank
FROM ranked AS r
ORDER BY r.district_population DESC, r.account_id ASC;

SELECT
    ba.account_id,
    ba.opening_date,
    lt.total_amount_borrowed,
    COALESCE(cc.outside_counterparty_count, 0) AS outside_counterparty_count,
    home.A2 AS home_district,
    home.A8 AS home_district_population,

JOIN district AS home
    ON home.district_id = c.district_id

    ON cc.account_id = ba.account_id

    FROM card c
    JOIN disp card_holder ON card_holder.disp_id = c.disp_id

SELECT
    CASE g.gender
        WHEN 'F' THEN 'women'
        WHEN 'M' THEN 'men'
        ELSE g.gender
    END AS gender,
    g.district_count,
    ed.district_id AS most_inhabited_district_id,
    ed.inhabitants AS most_inhabited_district_inhabitants,
    ROUND(g.average_salary, 2) AS average_salary,
    ROUND(g.average_urban_ratio, 2) AS average_urban_inhabitant_ratio
FROM grouped g
JOIN eligible_districts ed
  ON ed.gender = g.gender
 AND ed.inhabitants = g.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY
    CASE g.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    ed.district_id;

treatment.sql:
WITH account_avg AS (
    SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
gold_holders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT cl.gender, owner_disp.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.disp_id = c.disp_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
    JOIN account_avg AS aa
      ON aa.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
     AND aa.avg_balance > 1000
    WHERE c.type = 'gold'
),
qualifying_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           gh.gender,
           d.district_id,
           d.A2 AS district_name,
           CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
           d.A11 AS salary,
           d.A10 AS urban_ratio
    FROM gold_holders AS gh
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = gh.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) > 100000
),
summary AS (
    SELECT gender,
           COUNT(*) AS district_count,
           MAX(inhabitants) AS max_inhabitants,
           ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio), 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
    FROM qualifying_districts
    GROUP BY gender
)
SELECT CASE s.gender
           WHEN 'F' THEN 'women'
           WHEN 'M' THEN 'men'
           ELSE s.gender
       END AS gender,
       s.district_count,
       q.district_name,
       q.inhabitants AS most_inhabited_district_inhabitants,
       s.avg_salary,
       s.avg_urban_ratio
FROM summary AS s
JOIN qualifying_districts AS q
  ON q.gender = s.gender
 AND q.inhabitants = s.max_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE s.gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
         q.district_id;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS owner
      ON owner.account_id = a.account_id
     AND owner.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN card AS c
      ON c.disp_id = owner.disp_id
     AND c.type = 'gold'
    WHERE d.A4 >= 250000
),
pair_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.bank AS recipient_bank_code,
        t.account AS recipient_counter_account_number,
        COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN eligible_accounts AS e ON e.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pair_totals.*,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM pair_totals
)
SELECT
    recipient_bank_code,
    recipient_counter_account_number,
    outgoing_payment_count,
    total_amount_paid
FROM ranked
WHERE amount_rank = 1
ORDER BY recipient_bank_code, recipient_counter_account_number;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN disp d
      ON d.client_id = c.client_id
     AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE LOWER(c.gender) IN ('f', 'female')
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card ca
          WHERE ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
      )
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM loan l
          WHERE l.account_id = d.account_id
      )
),
regional_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           d.A3 AS region,
           d.district_id,
           d.A2 AS district_name,
           d.A8 AS inhabitants,
           d.A11 AS salary,
           d.A13 AS unemployment_1996
    FROM eligible e
    JOIN district d
      ON d.district_id = e.district_id
),
region_stats AS (
    SELECT region,
           ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
           ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996), 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996
    FROM regional_districts
    GROUP BY region
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT region,
           district_name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY region
               ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM regional_districts
)
SELECT s.region,
       s.avg_district_salary,
       s.avg_unemployment_1996,
       r.district_name AS most_populous_district
FROM region_stats s
JOIN ranked_districts r
  ON r.region = s.region
 AND r.rn = 1
ORDER BY s.region;

populous_rank AS (
  SELECT
    rd.region,
    d.A2 AS district_name,

WITH card_holders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.type AS card_type, cl.district_id
    FROM card c
    JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
    JOIN client cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
    WHERE lower(c.type) IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
holder_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ch.card_type,
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A8 AS inhabitants
    FROM card_holders ch
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ch.district_id
),
minima AS (
    SELECT card_type, MIN(inhabitants) AS min_inhabitants
    FROM holder_districts
    GROUP BY card_type
)
SELECT
    hd.card_type,
    hd.district_name AS home_district,
    hd.inhabitants
FROM holder_districts hd
JOIN minima m
    ON m.card_type = hd.card_type
   AND m.min_inhabitants = hd.inhabitants
ORDER BY hd.card_type, hd.district_name;

WITH lit_region AS (
  SELECT A3 AS region
  FROM district
  WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
opened AS (
  SELECT account_id, district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE date >= '1996-01-01'
    AND date < '1997-01-01'
),
latest_tx AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.account_id
      ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM trans t
  JOIN opened o ON o.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.date < '1997-01-01'
),
account_balances AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, o.district_id, lt.balance
  FROM opened o
  JOIN latest_tx lt
    ON lt.account_id = o.account_id
   AND lt.rn = 1
),
district_summary AS (
  SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
    ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS avg_end_1996_balance,
    AVG(ab.balance) AS avg_unrounded
  FROM account_balances ab
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
  WHERE d.A3 = (SELECT region FROM lit_region)
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
),
totals AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS region_avg_end_1996_balance
  FROM account_balances ab
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
  WHERE d.A3 = (SELECT region FROM lit_region)
)
SELECT
  ds.district_name,
  ds.accounts_opened,
  ds.avg_end_1996_balance,
  t.region_avg_end_1996_balance,
  FIRST_VALUE(ds.district_name) OVER (
    ORDER BY ds.avg_unrounded DESC, ds.district_name ASC
  ) AS highest_avg_district
FROM district_summary ds
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY ds.district_name;

),

SELECT

  MAX(CASE WHEN population_rank = 1 THEN inhabitants END) AS inhabitants,

WITH withdrawal_totals AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing_totals AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        COUNT(*) AS account_count,
        SUM(COALESCE(o.amount, 0)) AS total_standing_order_debit
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A4 AS population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        ROUND(1.0 * w.total_withdrawn / d.A4, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        ROUND(1.0 * s.total_standing_order_debit / s.account_count, 2)
            AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawal_totals AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN standing_totals AS s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC)
        AS withdrawal_per_inhabitant_rank,
    avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM qualifying
ORDER BY withdrawal_per_inhabitant_rank, district_name;

treatment.sql:
WITH district_withdrawals AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN trans AS t
        ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
district_orders AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(o.amount, 0)) AS total_standing_order_debit
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN "order" AS o
        ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A4 AS population,
        dw.total_withdrawn,
        1.0 * dw.total_withdrawn / d.A4 AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        1.0 * do.total_standing_order_debit / (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM account AS a
            WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
        ) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN district_withdrawals AS dw
        ON dw.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN district_orders AS do
        ON do.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_pressure_rank,
    ROUND(avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM qualifying
ORDER BY withdrawal_pressure_rank, district_name;

WITH client_home AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
accessible AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
           a.account_id,
           a.date AS opened_date,
           a.frequency,
           a.district_id AS account_district_id
    FROM disp AS p
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id
    WHERE p.client_id = 3541
),
trans_summary AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
regional_clients AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
),
ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id,
           A3 AS region,
           A2 AS district_name,
           A8 AS inhabitants,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A8 DESC) AS population_rank,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY A3
               ORDER BY A8 DESC, district_id
           ) AS pop_row
    FROM district
),
regional_populous AS (
    SELECT region, district_name, inhabitants
    FROM ranked_districts
    WHERE pop_row = 1
)
SELECT x.account_id,
       x.opened_date,
       x.frequency,
       d.A2 AS district_name,
       d.A3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN d.district_id = h.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
       d.A11 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       rc.client_count AS clients_in_region,
       rp.district_name AS most_populous_district,
       rp.inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
       rd.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM accessible AS x
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = x.account_district_id
CROSS JOIN client_home AS h
LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = x.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_summary AS ts ON ts.account_id = x.account_id
LEFT JOIN regional_clients AS rc ON rc.region = d.A3
LEFT JOIN regional_populous AS rp ON rp.region = d.A3
LEFT JOIN ranked_districts AS rd ON rd.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, x.account_id ASC;

treatment.sql:
WITH
client_home AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
accessible_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT account_id
    FROM disp
    WHERE client_id = 3541
),
account_stats AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opened_date,
        a.frequency,
        a.district_id,
        COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expense
    FROM accessible_accounts aa
    JOIN account a ON a.account_id = aa.account_id
    LEFT JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date, a.frequency, a.district_id
),
district_ranks AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        A2 AS district_name,
        A3 AS region,
        A8 AS inhabitants,
        A11 AS average_salary,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A8 DESC) AS population_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(A2) OVER (
            PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A8 DESC, district_id
        ) AS most_populous_district,
        FIRST_VALUE(A8) OVER (
            PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A8 DESC, district_id
        ) AS most_populous_inhabitants
    FROM district
),
region_client_counts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS home_client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT
    s.account_id,
    s.opened_date,
    s.frequency,
    dr.district_name,
    dr.region,
    CASE WHEN s.district_id = ch.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
    dr.average_salary,
    COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
    COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
    s.transaction_count,
    s.total_income,
    s.total_expense,
    s.total_income - s.total_expense AS net_balance,
    COALESCE(rcc.home_client_count, 0) AS clients_home_district_in_region,
    dr.most_populous_district,
    dr.most_populous_inhabitants,
    dr.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM account_stats s
CROSS JOIN client_home ch
JOIN district_ranks dr ON dr.district_id = s.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = s.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_client_counts rcc ON rcc.region = dr.region
ORDER BY s.transaction_count DESC, s.account_id ASC

baseline.sql:
WITH account_lending AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id,
    a.date,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS amount_lent
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN loan AS l
    ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'central Bohemia'
    AND a.date >= '1996-01-01'
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date
),
district_year AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', date) AS opening_year,
    district_id,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
    SUM(amount_lent) AS amount_lent
  FROM account_lending
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y', date), district_id
)
SELECT
  opening_year,
  SUM(accounts_opened) AS accounts_opened,
  SUM(amount_lent) AS total_amount_lent,
  ROUND(AVG(1.0 * amount_lent / accounts_opened), 2)

  LEFT JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
),

  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
    ac.number_of_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds, 0) AS number_of_bonds,
    ac.carbon_atoms,
    ac.chlorine_atoms,
    COALESCE(bc.carbon_touching_bonds, 0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
    COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE ac.carbon_atoms > 0

SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  molecule_id,
  carcinogenicity_label,
  number_of_atoms,

  chlorine_atoms,
  carbon_touching_bonds,
